platform: KCR College Radio Free FCC-Clean Digital Email Submission Opportunity
manual_review_reason: KCR explicitly authorizes digital submissions to kcr@sdsu.edu and requires FCC-clean MP3 files named Artist – Song Title. A human must select one suitable radio-ready track, confirm the exact master is clean, inspect MP3 encoding, filename and metadata, resolve attachment-size, track-count and download-link rules, verify international and non-local eligibility, composition, master, sample and contributor rights, release timing and the current AI-assisted or AI-generated music policy, avoid status calls or repetitive follow-up, and send manually.
